scope: 完整的动作、环境、采集、物品操作和战斗通知。初始译文来自 data/drafts/messages-*.json，按目录来源 ID 校对。显示模板以 Note 展开后的正文匹配。
exclusions: 未审定嵌套方括号、条件分支或 printf 二次格式化。物品检查的技能、攻防加成和双手惩罚依赖这些语法，留待单独核对。
跳过战斗轨迹、伤势状态与攻击连接词等可能拼接的片段，以及用途未明的提示。
只允许一个已知来源的文字槽。人物、物品和数量用同一个捕获片段传递，保留原生冠词、品质和数量。
只识别已审校的 FIRE 与 BURP 音效头。颜色前缀保留在匹配键中。
保留部分进食的专用句式；完整进食的宽泛句式也会匹配部分进食，暂不生成。

entries.original: !You can not strike with <item_ind>.
!Both parties manage to hurt each other.

!There's <npc_desc> in your way!

entries.translation: !你现在无法再继续治疗这处伤口。请明天再试。

entries.original: &You are not tired!

entries.translation: !你双手都在使用中！先卸下一件物品，才能装备新物品。

entries.translation: !你不能丢下身上穿着的东西。

entries.translation: !你带的东西太多了！丢下一些多余物品，才能继续大量采集。

+You draw your <fullitem> and prepare to shoot.

entries.original: &You sit down, spit in the water and start to angle, dreaming of a huge catch.
entries.translation: &你坐下来，朝水里吐了口唾沫，开始垂钓，幻想着能钓到一大批鱼。

entries.original: &You lower <the_item> into the water and start dragging it to find a fish to scoop in.
entries.translation: &你把<the_item>放入水中，开始拖动它，寻找可以捞起的鱼。

entries.original: &You prepare to strike your <item> at the fish that may approach here.
entries.translation: &你握好<item>，准备刺向游过来的鱼。

entries.original: !This is shallow waters fishing method. It's too deep to fish with <item> here.
entries.translation: !这是浅水捕鱼法。这里水太深，无法用<item>捕鱼。

entries.original: You didn't manage to catch any fish.
_The catch now awaits at your feet to be picked up.
entries.translation: _渔获就在你的脚边，等你捡起。

entries.original: !There are no nets beside you. Nothing to retrieve.
entries.translation: !你身边没有渔网。没有东西可收。

entries.original: &You start retrieving the net from the water...
There are no fish in this net.
+That <fullitem> is damaged and worn out beyond usable condition.
entries.translation: +那张<fullitem>已经破损，无法继续使用。

{BURP}=Burp! Your stomach is full.

:You begin sneaking, trying to stay hidden and move as quietly as possible.
entries.translation: :你开始潜行，尽量不被发现，并且安静地移动。

entries.original: :You quit hiding and sneaking.
!You can't hide now as you are clearly seen at this location.
entries.translation: !你现在无法躲藏，因为你在这里明显可见。

entries.translation: !若还要收集种子，你必须使用 AGRICULTURE 技能采收<item_def>。

entries.original: !To gather the seeds, harvest <item_def> after its flowering period.
entries.translation: !要收集种子，请在<item_def>花期结束后收割。

entries.original: !<item_def> here is past its flowering period and will not yield flowers.
entries.translation: !这里的<item_def>已经过了花期，不会再长出花朵。

entries.original: !This <item> no longer provides any yield nor carries any usable parts.
entries.translation: !这株<item>已经没有收成，也没有可用的部分。

entries.original: !This early-harvested <item> doesn't provide any yield.
entries.translation: !过早采收的<item>不会有任何收成。

entries.translation: !这种<item>没有可采摘的有用部分，请尝试收割并脱粒。

entries.original: !The <item> here has been picked already!
Ok. You harvested down <items_ind>.

=Ok. You planted a patch of <item> here. Time will tell how many will sprout.
entries.translation: =完成。你在这里种下了一片<item>。过段时间就知道有多少能发芽了。

entries.original: You don't notice any tracks around here.
entries.translation: 你没有注意到附近有任何足迹。

entries.original: =You find some tracks here.
=You spot some tracks close by.
You peer into the water. Your reflection peers back at you.
entries.translation: 你朝水里窥望，水中的倒影也回望着你。

entries.original: You think you see something moving in the depths but then it's gone.
entries.translation: 你觉得深处似乎有什么东西在移动，但转眼就不见了。

entries.translation: !<npc_defdesc>明确表示不允许你给她挤奶。

entries.original: !Milk <npc_defdesc>? Nay, think again.

entries.translation: !看来<npc_defdesc>今天已经不能再产奶了。

entries.original: !<npc_defdesc> is having a dry period. No milk until the next spring.
entries.translation: !<npc_defdesc>正处于停乳期。要等到下一个春天才有奶。

entries.original: Ok. <the_fullitem> you have will be used.
!You should have the carcass nearby on the ground, one step away at the most.
entries.translation: !地上附近应该有动物尸体，最远不能超过一步。

entries.original: #You finalize cleaning the skin and set it properly in place for curing.
entries.translation: #你完成了清理兽皮的工作，并将它放好以便保存。

entries.original: +The skin is now left to dry completely, after which it will keep for future usage.
entries.translation: +兽皮现在会彻底晾干，之后可以保存待用。

entries.original: #You start to scrape and rinse the skin clean from any remaining flesh and fat.
entries.translation: #你开始刮洗兽皮，清除残留的肉和脂肪。

entries.original: #You start to rub the tanning material on the skin.
entries.translation: #你开始把鞣制材料揉擦到兽皮上。

entries.original: #The skin is now left alone for the tanning material to get working.
entries.translation: #现在将兽皮放在一旁，让鞣制材料发挥作用。

entries.original: #You scrape off the tanning mixture and rinse the skin clean.
entries.translation: #你刮掉鞣制混合物，并把兽皮冲洗干净。

entries.original: #The skin is now left to hang until it's dry enough to continue tanning.
entries.translation: #兽皮现在会悬挂晾晒，直到干燥到可以继续鞣制。

entries.original: #You start softening the skin by pounding, stretching, squeezing and cursing - the final and the most laborious stage of tanning.
entries.translation: #你开始捶打、拉伸、挤压兽皮，还一边咒骂，以此软化兽皮——这是鞣制过程中最后也是最费力的阶段。

entries.original: !The water is too cold for retting! It is not possible now.
entries.translation: !水温太低，无法浸沤！现在不能进行这项操作。

entries.original: #You proceed to start pounding the tendon to separate the sinew fibres.
entries.translation: #你开始敲打筋腱，以分离筋腱纤维。

entries.translation: #你接下来直接用手从<the_item>中抽取纤维。

entries.translation: !数量太少！至少需要<items>，才能提取出实用数量的纤维。

entries.original: #Now you need to break and clean away the stems to release and obtain the fibres.
entries.translation: #现在需要打碎茎秆并清理掉它们，才能释放并取得纤维。
